title: Molecule definition
description: A molecule's definition (AD-9, design decisions 2 and 3): the definition format it follows, its name and version, its parameters as a JSON Schema, its composition of exactly one widget item in format 1.0.0, and, per parameter, the JSON Pointers into the composition that the parameter fills, each with a declarative form: copy (no as), item, entries or omit. Data only: no fill evaluates anything. What a schema cannot say (the format's major, the parameters' dialect, $id and shape, each fill's parameter and pointer, no markup or script in any string) is checked by moleculeDefinitionProblems. In no schema set until the input format reaches 1.1.

parameters.description: The JSON Schema 2020-12 of the data a reference sends, with the $id urn:askboard:molecule:<molecule>:<major>.

items.description: The composition: in format 1.0.0, exactly one widget item.

fills.description: Per top-level parameter, the places in the composition it fills.

name.description: A molecule's name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

version.description: A semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, with no leading zero.

item.description: A widget item {type, id, props}; the expansion gives it the ID <reference>__<id>.

fill.description: An RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into items, and the form of the fill: a copy when as is absent.

anyOf.description: The value names an item of the ask: a molecule reference's expanded item replaces it.

entries.description: Each value v of an object becomes the entry {<entries>: v}.

omit.description: A copy without these keys in any object, at any depth.
